ir.name: loss_pairwise_relativistic_advantage_exp_clamped_repair
ir.intuition: Fix by clamping normalized advantage gap to avoid zeros and ensure stable weighted terms for correct gradient.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_gap = advantage_l - advantage_w
adv_norm = normalize(adv_gap).clamp(min=eps)
diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
exp_diff = exp(diff)
weighted_exp = exp_diff * adv_norm * weight
loss = mean(-log(weighted_exp / (1 + weighted_exp)))
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))
    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']

    advantage_gap = ops.sub(adv_l, adv_w)  # reversed order for correct gradient direction
    advantage_norm = ops.normalize(advantage_gap)
    advantage_norm = ops.clamp(advantage_norm, min=eps)

    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    exp_diff = ops.exp(diff)

    weighted_exp = ops.mul(exp_diff, advantage_norm)
    weighted_exp = ops.mul(weighted_exp, weight)
    weighted_exp = ops.clamp(weighted_exp, min=eps)

    log_w_exp = ops.log(weighted_exp)
    log_denom = ops.log(ops.add(weighted_exp, ops.ones_like(weighted_exp)))
    loss = ops.neg(ops.sub(log_w_exp, log_denom))

    return ops.mean(loss)
